entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 06.07.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Pachamba P.S. Case No.56 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 456 & 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It appears that the applicant is accused of committing rape upon the victim.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5.
Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
Further, it has been submitted that the entire allegation is false and frivolous and he has been implicated due to neighbourhood dispute.
It has further been submitted that although the victim immediately went to the police station but neither medical report nor any neutral material corroborates the allegation.

sentences.text: , prayer for bail has been made.
6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the above facts, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Giridih in connection with Pachamba P.S. Case No.56 of 2022, subject to condition that the applicant(s) will submit self-attested photocopy/photocopies of his/her/their Aadhaar Card(s) and also submit his/her/their mobile number(s) before the learned court below which he/she/they will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
